summary: The listing price is ₹7,780 and the M.R.P. is ₹11,995, with a claimed 35% off. There were too few matching stores to judge the price.

voices.point: Users praise quiet operation, quick cooking, and easy temperature or time adjustments.
Several reviewers say it is easy to use and clean, with a touch screen display.
Some users mention the instructions are not detailed enough for setup and cooking basics.
A few users say the basket can be small for two people or larger meals.
